newsitem.title: UK: BTR sells two businneses for 40 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: BTR sells two businneses for 40 mln stg.

text.p: Industrial conglomerate BTR Plc said on Tuesday that it has sold two businesses as part of its ongoing disposal programme for 40 million stg.

BTR sold Dunlopillo UK, which manufactures a range of latex foam bedding products, to management and Dunlopillo (Germany) and Dunloplan to SP Reifenwerke, the German-based subsidiary of Sumitomo Rubber Industries Ltd.

"The disposal of these non core businesses is a further step in our strategy of focusing resources on industrial manufacturing and engineering businesses," said Ian Strachan, chief executive of BTR in a statement.
